prompt_templates.abstain_text: If a figure is not reported in the text, set that key to null. Do not guess.
prompt_templates.closed_book:
No document is provided. From your own knowledge, state these figures from the 10-K that {company} filed for the fiscal year ended {period_end}.
Return JSON only, no other text, with these keys: {fields}.
For each key give an object with: value (a number in full US dollars), unit, period (the fiscal period it covers), and quote (set this to null, because there is no document to quote).
{extra}
prompt_templates.closed_answer: Give your best answer for every key, even if you are unsure.
prompt_templates.closed_abstain: If you do not know a figure, set that key to null. Do not guess.
prompt_templates.retrieved_note: The text below is a set of passages retrieved from the filing by a keyword search. It is not the whole filing, and the passages may not be complete statements.
prompt_templates.fewshot_intro: Here are worked examples from other companies' filings, showing the expected output. Your filing follows them.

retrieval.method: BM25 (sparse keyword ranking, not neural embeddings)

queries.revenue: total revenue net sales revenues consolidated statements of operations
queries.net_income: net income attributable consolidated statements of income
queries.operating_income: operating income income from operations consolidated statements of operations

rules: Only values reported in this exact 10-K (matching accession number) and fiscal period end.
Flow items (revenue, net income, operating income) must cover 340-380 days.
The first tag in each list that has a value is the key; other tags that disagree by more than 0.1% mark the item as ambiguous.
Net income is NetIncomeLoss (attributable to the parent) before ProfitLoss.

classes.wrong_value: a number that does appear in the filing, but is not the SEC value (wrong line, period or column)
classes.not_in_text: a number that appears nowhere in the filing: fabricated or recalled wrongly
classes.missing: no answer given (when the model was not allowed to abstain)
classes.abstained: the model answered null when it was allowed to
classes.bad_json: the reply could not be parsed
classes.no_section: the financial statement could not be located in the filing, so the model was never asked
classes.answered_no_key: the model gave a number but SEC has no value to check it against
classes.no_key: no SEC value and no answer: not scored

model_settings.temperature: not settable on these models; repeats measure the spread
